answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 19526 Country: India Title: What is the correct way of offering of Salatul Kusuf? Is congregation a must? Is it a Jahri or Sirri prayer? And lastly what about the number of Ruku in a rakat? Jazak Allah Question: What is the correct way of offering of Salatul Kusuf? Is congregation a must? Is it a Jahri or Sirri prayer? And lastly what about the number of Ruku in a rakat? Jazak Allah Answer ID: 19526 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 281/281/L=1431) At the time of Kusoof (solar eclipse), two rak?at salah is Sunnah . It should be performed with jama?at . And it is sunnah to recite long surah such as Al-Baqarah etc with long rukoo and saj?dah, and the recitation should be slow. وسن تطويلهما بنحو سورة البقره وسن تطويل ركوعهما و سجودهما (طحاوي) و يخفى القراءة عند أبي حنيفة و عندهما بجهر و عن محمد كقول أبي حنيفة (كبيري) After salah, the imam will perform dua while all the muqtadi will say Amen until the Kusoof comes to an end. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
